input.summary: Move governing law to New York, fix New York County venue, and remove the conflicting mandatory AAA arbitration mechanic.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have moved the governing law to New York (our playbook's preferred position) and confirmed exclusive venue in the state and federal courts in New York County. We also deleted the mandatory AAA arbitration sentence, which contradicts that exclusive court jurisdiction; the jury-trial waiver and limitation period are unchanged.

ops.oldText: the laws of the State of Delaware without giving effect to its conflict of laws principles. Each Party hereby irrevocably submits for all disputes to the exclusive jurisdiction and venue of the state and federal courts located in New York, New York.
